_meta.description: PVWatts v8 hourly AC output for a 1 kW_DC fixed roof-mount system in Los Angeles, CA (TMY). Value i = AC energy (kWh) in hour i of a 365-day typical year, hour-beginning, local standard time (UTC-8, no DST), i=0 is Jan 1 00:00-01:00. Multiply by system kW_DC for any size.
_meta.source: NREL/NLR PVWatts Calculator API v8 (National Laboratory of the Rockies, formerly NREL); weather: NSRDB PSM V3 GOES tmy-2020 3.2.0
_meta.note: API outputs.ac is hourly AC system output in Wac for system_capacity=1 kW; converted to kWh by /1000 and rounded to 4 decimals (negative nighttime values, if any, clipped to 0). Time convention: the PVWatts v8 docs page does not state it; hour-beginning local standard time (station tz -8) is INFERRED from the diurnal symmetry around solar noon (e.g. San Jose mean of hour 11 = 0.601 vs hour 12 = 0.608 kWh/kW; nights are 0). TMY has 8760 hours (no Feb 29): for the 2024 (8784 h) analysis calendar, reuse Feb 28 for Feb 29 or map by (month, day, hour). Weather is a typical meteorological year, not 2024 actual weather. API warnings: []

location_source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Gazetteer Files, Places (California), INTPTLAT/INTPTLONG
